$comment: Test fixture: a nested layout with numeric-prefixed cross-cutting layers, kept to prove that layout stays reproducible through config. Not an example for users, see ../../crew.example.json.

specFirst.$comment: Before an existing production file under a root is edited, a test file must already be touched under the same module: modified, staged, untracked, or committed ahead of origin/<baseBranch>. Without a specFirst block the hook does nothing.

roots.$comment: services/core/src/<context>/...: the first directory under the root is the module. Top-level directories prefixed NN_ (00_adapters, 04_gateway-*) are cross-cutting layers: a test anywhere under the root satisfies them.
